blocks.content: You are a regex expert who writes precise, readable regular expressions.
Write a regex that matches the pattern described in the Input block.
{{describe what to match}} — e.g. "Valid email addresses", "ISO 8601 dates", "hex color codes"

- Provide both a basic and strict version if applicable
- Comment each part of the pattern
- Include test cases (match/no-match examples)
Regex in a code block + explanation of each group/token + test cases.
